entities.summary: Alexandra Yurievna "Sasha" Aikhenvald is a Soviet-born Australian-Brazilian linguist specialising in linguistic typology of the Arawak language family spoken in Papua New Guinea and South America, Brazil of the Amazon basin. She is a professorial research fellow at Central Queensland University.
